messages:
alex_m: Heads up — after rolling NVIDIA 550.40 to us-west-staging (canary group), ~8/65 GPU nodes are failing to finish boot. DKMS probe errors during initramfs stage, looks like kernel headers/symlink mismatch. Observed from cloud-init logs. :grimacing:

linh: Can you paste the dkms/dmesg bits? curious if it's the usual header version mismatch or a new symbol error.

alex_m: Paste from one failing host:
```
Jun 12 03:12:05 boot kernel: nvidia: module license 'NVIDIA' taints kernel.
Jun 12 03:12:05 boot kernel: nvidia: disagrees about version of symbol module_layout
Jun 12 03:12:05 boot dkms: ERROR: Failed to build module nvidia/550.40 for kernel 5.15.0-1026-aws (headers missing?)
Jun 12 03:12:05 boot cloud-init[1234]: /lib/modules/5.15.0-1026-aws/build -> /usr/src/linux-headers-5.15.0-1026-aws (symlink present but points to wrong tree)
```

priya: That's the classic 'headers package not matching running kernel' scenario. But two oddities: 1) the symlink exists but points at an older headers dir, and 2) a few nodes show NCCL warnings after partial driver load: "NCCL WARN No system topology found" — means driver loaded partially and CUDA runtime is unhappy.

jon: Impact: we drained batch jobs off the affected nodes, jobs retrying. Estimate ~12% of staging GPUs unavailable; scheduler already moved some jobs but pressure on other pools.

linh: Quick triage checklist:
- check `uname -r` vs `/usr/src/linux-headers-$(uname -r)`
- run `dkms status`
- inspect `/var/lib/dkms/nvidia/550.40/build/make.log`
If headers missing, `apt-get install --reinstall linux-headers-$(uname -r)` usually fixes.

priya: Also watch for leftover modules from previous driver: rmmod can leave stale .ko links in `/lib/modules/$(uname -r)/updates/dkms/`. If dkms build finds those, modprobe can fail with "disagrees about version of symbol". Recommended cleanup steps (on one failing host to test):
```
sudo apt-get purge -y nvidia-dkms-*
sudo rm -rf /lib/modules/$(uname -r)/updates/dkms/*
sudo apt-get install -y linux-headers-$(uname -r)
sudo dkms autoinstall
sudo depmod -a
sudo update-initramfs -u -k $(uname -r)
```

alex_m: We need a fast mitigation: pausing the 550 rollout. Linh, can you add a header/version check into the rollout job so it aborts when headers don't match? Something like: `if [ ! -d /usr/src/linux-headers-$(uname -r) ]; then exit 1; fi`

linh: On it. I'll open a tiny PR to the rollout job to validate headers and `dkms status` before installing. Also will add a canary step that runs a post-install `modprobe nvidia` and validates `nvidia-smi` comes up.

jon: Also flagging capacity: please coordinate with SRE to increase dedicated pool capacity for prod-like tests — don't want a global rollback to impact customer queues. I'll spin up 10 extra dedicated nodes in us-west-temp pool for the next 2 hours.

infra-bot: Incident INFRA-6123 created: "DKMS probe failures after NVIDIA 550.40 canary — us-west-staging" — assignees: linh, priya, alex_m. ETA: rollback started. :rotating_light:

priya: One more gotcha we saw: some EC2 AMIs have custom kernel packaging (aws-kernel variants). Those nodes ended up with a different naming scheme for headers so `linux-headers-$(uname -r)` didn't resolve. For those, you need the cloud provider's kernel-headers package or install the generic package. I'll add a short doc in the ticket.

alex_m: Decision: pausing global rollout, aborting remaining canaries, rollback 550.40 -> 535.x on canary pool. Linh to patch rollout, Priya to run cleanup+rebuild on failing nodes, Jon to provision buffer capacity. Update in 30m. :thumbsup:
